Chapter 561: Chapter 12 Hang in there, I’m going to weave through (Please subscribe)

“`

“Another opportunity for fortune has emerged?”

Xilan’s expression was one of shock, “Such celestial fluctuations… are the strongest I’ve ever seen; the treasures inside must be at least comparable to an Eleven-Star cosmic rarity, or even reaching the pinnacle level of Eleven-Star…”

Xilan had entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm numerous times,

having witnessed the birth of many such places of fortune, she was quite knowledgeable about them,

thus, the instant she perceived the fluctuations, she was able to roughly estimate their value.

...

“Eleven-Star, or even the pinnacle quality of Eleven-Star cosmic rarities?” Lin Yuan was also somewhat tempted.

If the World Tree is of Eleven-Star supreme quality, could the treasures inside this distant place of opportunity possibly achieve that level?

Such treasures, even within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, are extremely rare, and not every opening of the realm yields them.

While Lin Yuan and Xilan observed from within the layers of space,

two powerful auras instantly penetrated numerous Spatial Layers.

Boom!!!

Boom!!!!!

“Hahaha, this place of fortune is mine.” Accompanied by a terrifying laugh, a tall figure in a black robe appeared above the place of opportunity.

He casually reached out with his right hand and extracted a treasure radiating a dim gray aura.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan and Xilan trembled inwardly; the tall figure in the black robe emitted fluctuations that far surpassed the Ninth Rank of the Myriad Heavy Realm, and the Spatial Layers he had opened were at least over twenty million.

“That treasure, it seems like I saw a galaxy being nurtured within it…” Xilan muttered to herself.

Such a treasure has no equivalent in the Main Universe, but to provoke such a powerful being, who had opened over twenty million Spatial Layers, to act personally,

its value is bound to be immeasurable.

“We must leave quickly.”

Lin Yuan’s resistance to the allure of the treasures was much stronger than Xilan’s.

Having confirmed that the treasure had been taken, he immediately prepared to distance himself.

The attention of that powerful being should still be on the treasure; they should be able to leave without any issues at present.

“Right.”

“We need to hurry.”

Xilan also came to her senses.

Although she wasn’t certain of the identity of the figure in the black robe, Xilan was sure he wasn’t a Human Evolver.

If he were, he would have triggered a response from the black disc by now.

This was a treasure given to every Human Evolver by Human Civilization, used to identify and locate each other in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Since he wasn’t a Human Evolver, if he discovered Lin Yuan and Xilan nearby, he surely wouldn’t mind an extra bit of profit.

“Let’s go, go, go.”

Xilan, trying to smooth the fluctuations between the Spatial Layers, led Lin Yuan quickly away in another direction.

Just then,

another aura burst forth.

In the distance, another figure bathed in a milky white aura appeared, looking dissatisfiedly at the figure in the black robe.

“Still a step too late.”

The figure surrounded by the milky white aura frowned deeply, not attempting to fight for the treasure.

The figure in the black robe was no weaker than him, and even if he took action, it would not result in gaining the treasure but merely venting frustration, which was pointless.

“Hahaha, Hunyi, I’ll take my leave first. The treasure of the highest value in this Xuanhuang Secret Realm should be this one I have…”

The black-robed figure laughed heartily as his figure once again vanished.

Leaving behind ‘Hunyi,’ standing there enveloped in milky white aura, with twelve pairs of wings on his back.

As the strongest among the Peak Clans, the Tianyu Clan of this generation, Hunyi’s foray into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm hadn’t yielded much.

The Galaxy Master he so wanted to find was like a mouse, hiding somewhere unknown.

“Hmm?”

Hunyi’s awareness spread in all directions, permeating the numerous Spatial Layers, intending to randomly capture a few ‘ants’ to vent his frustration.

Suddenly,

Hunyi’s expression changed slightly, looking in a particular direction.

This direction was precisely where Xilan and Lin Yuan were fleeing.

“Human scent… the Galactic Star Lord?”

Hunyi’s spirit lifted, and with a slight spread of his twelve pairs of white wings, his form disappeared from its original spot.

“We must move fast.”

“The strong presence coming from behind should be the ‘Hunyi’ of the Tianyu Clan.”

Xilan’s expression was serious; she hadn’t recognized the figure in the black robe, but the appearance of the figure enveloped in the milky white aura was very likely from the Tianyu Clan.

Among the many strong beings from the Tianyu Clan who had entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, those with such power were highly likely to be ‘Hunyi.’

“Hunyi?”

Lin Yuan also felt the pressure.

He had long learned from the Maduo Traveler that Hunyi was searching for him everywhere to avenge the humiliation suffered on the Battlefields of Different Races.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was vast, and coupled with Lin Yuan’s lack of interest in those places of opportunity, Hunyi finding his location was like looking for a needle in a haystack.

He just didn’t expect his luck to be so bad that on the main road to the realm’s core area, he happened upon the opening of a place of fortune.

And the celestial phenomena caused by this opening had attracted Hunyi.

Even Lin Yuan found the coincidence almost unbelievable.

Could he be that unlucky?

“Hahaha.”

“Galactic Star Lord, do you think you can get away?”

Silently, a voice echoed in their ears, and at the same time, a vast, holy aura began to close in rapidly.

“Is it Hunyi who’s pursuing us?”

Xilan’s heart trembled; she actually had some hope that Hunyi had not noticed them.

From the beginning, she and Lin Yuan had been hiding deep within the layers of space, as long as Hunyi didn’t actively probe into the Spatial Layers, he wouldn’t detect their lingering presence.

After several breaths, the auras would dissipate, and even a being as powerful as Hunyi wouldn’t know where they had fled.
